body:
From the #793/#942 follow-up (`fix/793-942-sampling`).

**Tier:** DECISION (@ligon). This raised from red team r1 on `fix/793-942-sampling`, §5 H2/H3. Both choices change only **when the warning fires**: nothing served moves under any option, and the cost is 0 hashes either way (`.yml` / read-path code).

**As built:** a `Country(...)` frame carrying `v` warns for every boundary declared `wave-scoped` / `redefined` / `mixed` that lies between the frame's first and last wave in `Country.waves` order. There is no size threshold.

#### Measurements

The measurement (2026-10-19, `$STAGE/scratch/h2h3.py` / `h2_summary.py`) took every 2-wave request over the five curated countries: **119 requests** (31 of them adjacent):

| country | requests |
|---|---|
| GhanaLSS | 21 |
| Ethiopia | 10 |
| Tanzania | 15 |
| Uganda | 28 |
| Nigeria | 45 |

The ground truth for each request comes from `Country(C).sample()`: the households present in both waves with `v` on both sides, and how many of them keep `v`.

- 27 requests link no household, so the truth there is indeterminate.
- In 13, every linked household keeps `v`.
- In 33, none does.
- In 46, some do and some don't. 14 of these 46 are `stable` boundaries whose only changes are movers (`moved-` singletons / tracked moves).

The rules were simulated through `sampling.audit_cluster_identity` on the shipped records, including the Uganda 2011-12 `wave-scoped` change made in r1.

#### H2: which boundaries count

| rule | requests that warn | warns where every linked household keeps `v` | silent where NO linked household keeps `v` | silent where a declared renumbering lies inside |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SPAN** (as built: every boundary inside [first, last]) | 77 | **3** | **0** of 33 | 0 |
| **ADJ-a** (only boundaries whose two endpoints are both requested) | 12 | 0 | **26** of 33 | 27 |
| **ADJ-b** (the later requested wave's own record, whatever precedes it) | 41 | 3 | **13** of 33 | — |

- **SPAN's three over-warnings** are all cases where the renumbering cancels across the span:
  - Tanzania `['2008-09','2014-15']`: 424/424 keep.
  - Tanzania `['2010-11','2014-15']`: 413/413 keep.
  - Uganda `['2005-06','2011-12']`: 2,368/2,368 keep, because both waves use the 8-digit rendering.
- **What ADJ-a misses** (none-keep, silent), with the large ones named:
  - Ethiopia `['2011-12','2015-16']`: 3,639 linked, 0 keep.
  - Tanzania `['2014-15','2020-21']`: 3,042 linked, 0 keep.
  - Tanzania `['2012-13','2019-20']`: 483 linked, 0 keep.
  - 20 Uganda pairs across the EA -> parish -> name changes of kind, e.g. `['2013-14','2019-20']`: 2,489 linked, 0 keep.
  - ADJ-a also misses Tanzania `['2008-09','2012-13']` (607 of 2,980 change; the round-3 renumbering).
- **Default all-wave calls** warn for all five countries under every rule, because each has an in-frame non-stable boundary.
- **The trade:** SPAN buys zero misses for 3 over-warnings, a precision of 65 of 68 among requests that link households. ADJ-a buys zero over-warnings for 26 complete misses. ADJ-b sits between them and still misses Ethiopia `['2011-12','2015-16']`.
- **A fourth option, not built:** SPAN plus an exemption when the two requested waves' `v` is *declared* comparable directly. That needs a pairwise record the per-boundary schema does not have.

#### H3: no threshold for a partial renumbering

Each warned boundary, with the share of linked households whose `v` changes **excluding movers' `moved-` singletons**:

| boundary | declared | linked | `v` changes (all causes) | of which the renumbering itself |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nigeria 2016Q1 -> 2018Q3 | wave-scoped | 1,493 | 79 (5.3%) | **10 (0.67%)**: 1 EA, `16/1624/136 -> 16/1622/136` |
| Nigeria 2019Q1 -> 2023Q3 | wave-scoped | 5,067 | 343 (6.8%) | **112 (2.2%)**: 12 whole EAs re-assigned to another LGA |
| Tanzania 2010-11 -> 2012-13 | wave-scoped | 2,904 | 591 (20.4%) | 591: 82 of 409 clusters renumbered |
| Tanzania 2012-13 -> 2014-15 | wave-scoped | 521 | 108 (20.7%) | 108: 58 of them revert the round-3 renumbering |
| Uganda 2009-10 -> 2010-11 | mixed | 2,640 | 821 (31.1%) | 821: synthetic `@lat,lon` bins |
| the other 7 (GhanaLSS 1988-89, Ethiopia 2013-14, Tanzania 2019-20, Uganda 2009-10 / 2011-12 / 2013-14 / 2018-19) | — | — | 100% | 100% |

Which boundaries still warn, by threshold on the renumbering share:

| threshold on the renumbering share | boundaries still warning (of 12) | dropped |
|---|---|---|
| none (as built) | 12 | — |
| > 1% | 11 | Nigeria 2018Q3 |
| > 5% | 10 | both Nigeria boundaries: **Nigeria then never warns** (they are its only non-stable boundaries) |
| > 25% | 8 | plus both Tanzania round-3/4 boundaries |

- Today every Nigeria multi-wave call spanning W3 -> W4 says "do not cluster standard errors on `v` across these waves" for a defect affecting 0.67% of linked households.
- "No threshold" matches the repo's no-allowlist rule (`_grain_strict`, Sites B/Q/I). A threshold would be a magic number of exactly the kind CLAUDE.md declines elsewhere.
- **Middle option:** keep warning, but quote the share in the message's first line (the notes already carry it), so a reader can judge the size.

#### Questions

1. **H2.** Keep SPAN (as built), switch to ADJ-a or ADJ-b, or build the pairwise exemption?
2. **H3.** Keep no threshold; add a threshold (which value, and on households or clusters?); or keep no threshold but surface the share in the warning's first line?

comments.body:
**RULING (@ligon, 2026-10-19):**
- **H2:** keep **SPAN** as built. Every non-stable boundary between the first and last requested wave counts: zero misses, at the cost of 3 over-warnings.
- **H3:** **no threshold**, but the warning's first line must state the size of the renumbering for each boundary: clusters renumbered and the share of linked households whose `v` changes, net of movers. A reader can then judge a 0.67% boundary (Nigeria 2016Q1 -> 2018Q3) against a 100% one.

**Remaining work (tier A, read-path only, 0 hashes):** carry the measured counts in each boundary's `panel:` record, or compute them at warn time if that is cheap, and put them in the message's first line. Test with Nigeria 2016Q1 -> 2018Q3 and one 100% boundary.

title: DECISION (#942): `ClusterIdentityWarning`: which boundaries count (H2: any in span vs adjacent), and whether a partial renumbering needs a size threshold (H3)
